construction: An original procedural museum combines deterministic ray-cast corridors, generated exhibit identities, explicit viewport/probe/light observation predicates, probe-held blind thresholds, and a darkness-only final dock transfer. No source level, art, text, map, or asset is copied.
license_note: No third-party image, audio, code, font, model, texture, or other presentation asset is bundled. All visible geometry and exhibit art are rendered from repository-authored Canvas, HTML, and CSS primitives.
